requirement_match.summary: Approved smaller safe local navigation/loading change matches source and rendered tests. Optional Ask persistence omitted under its safety condition; no before/after FPS claim. Product-content and eight-principle review passed in disclosed web proxy.

security.summary: No new data cache, authentication/authorization change, write path, dependency or secret handling. Intent loading is same-origin and bounded to offered code modules; identity/path resets remain.

code_quality.summary: Current frontend TypeScript and scoped ESLint passed. Task-only delta preserves WIP; code cache deduplicates concurrent loads and releases rejected local requests. Native module-cache limitation documented.

failure_paths.summary: Seven unit and six browser tests passed. Held module navigation can be interrupted; default loading stays inline after elapsed threshold; failed preload has navigation/reload recovery; progress ownership failures/overlap remain tested.

error_handling.summary: Optional preload rejections are owned; navigation errors retain ErrorBoundary reload recovery. Loading status and aria-busy remain. Explicit progress finally-cleanup is unchanged.

production_readiness.summary: Reviewed deployment boundary: no deploy, migration, dependencies or backend changes. Local bundle generation passed with size warnings. Actual production readiness remains NOT_READY; indexes stale and real device/provider tests absent.

trade_offs.summary: Decorative entrance motion removed while interaction feedback retained. No hidden-tab mounting/private-data retention. After-only local metrics observed zero long tasks with supported API, but no universal smoothness or quantified improvement claim.

findings.summary: Slow-module observation previously used absolute document time and could miss the overlay threshold.
findings.resolution: Measure elapsed navigation time beyond 450ms; final full six-test browser suite passed (13.3s).

residual_risks: Production and physical-device behavior untested; no pre-change CPU/FPS trace. Existing large chunks remain.
Ask route/user reset retained to prevent stale route context; explicit Profile overlays remain without blur.
Native module cache may require reload following a failed fetch.
limitations: Source-based DEGRADED repository intelligence; both index health queries passed but freshness stale.
Review scoped to task candidate, not all shared worktree changes.
Accessibility evidence uses current DOM/ARIA, keyboard, zoom and rendered screenshots; no native screen-reader speech test.
Provider token usage and cost unavailable.
